environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x deployed on EC2 behind a basic NLB (Network Load Balancer) with no WAF. Thymeleaf templates use th:src with unescaped model attributes. No Content-Security-Policy headers configured. CDN_BASE_URL set to public CDN without access controls. Application serves on port 8080 directly. No request size limits configured in application.properties. Tomcat maxPostSize set to -1 (unlimited).
